# GIFTSYZ

> GIFTSYZ is a corporate gifting company in Bengaluru, India. It is the gifting arm of 4SYZ, a workplace services company. It offers curated corporate hampers, festive and occasion gifting, and sustainable gifts for teams, clients and partners.

## What it offers
- Corporate gifting: hampers and gifts for employees, clients and partners
- Wedding and festive gifting
- Sustainable gifting made with natural and recycled materials
- Shubhashaya: the luxury gifting line ("Gifts with Intention")

## How it works
- The landing page is public. The product catalogue is available after signing in.
- Signed-in customers can search and filter products, keep a wishlist with estimated quantities and customization notes, and ask for a quotation.
- Quotation requests are answered with a custom proposal within 4 business hours. Minimum order quantities apply and bulk pricing is available on request.
